summary: Columns, ontology terms, sample->run mapping, labels, digest split and technical metadata are supported by PRIDE, the paper (PMC8628316) and the deposited mzid. One important defect: comment[fraction identifier] is a per-series position counter rather than the physical bRP fraction, so identical identifiers denote different fractions across series (e.g. PBS_rep2_F05 = 2, PBS_rep1 F18 = 19).

Positional fraction scheme is disclosed in limitations but still misstates the fraction (scored under design).

findings.location: comment[fraction identifier], all 414 rows (e.g. PBS_rep2_F05.raw rows -> 2; PBS_rep1_F18.raw -> 19; PFF_rep2_F21.raw -> 19; A53T_control_rep2_LysC_F10.raw -> 9; PBS_rep1_F24.raw -> 31)
findings.message: Fraction identifier is the file's position in its sorted series, not the bRP fraction. The same identifier denotes different physical fractions across technical replicates/mice (rep1 F05=5 vs rep2 F05=2), which breaks fraction-aware reprocessing (OpenMS fraction groups) and violates 'fraction identifier consistent across samples' / no counter-as-row-index (validation.md, existing-annotation.md counter_abuse). Correction criterion: Every unsuffixed file and every lone suffixed file (e.g. PFF_rep2_F08b..F12_b) must carry its nominal fraction number (F05 -> 5); the same identifier must mean the same physical fraction in every series. For base+suffix duplicate acquisitions of one fraction (F17/F17b, f09/f09a, F19/F19b/F19c ...), choose an evidence-backed encoding that keeps the nominal number visible and still satisfies the dedup coordinate, and document it.
findings.evidence: File names carry the nominal fraction (F01-F24, paper: concatenated to 24 fractions); gaps (PBS_rep2 F02-F04, PFF_rep2 F17-F20, A53T_control_rep2 F09) and re-acquisitions (F17b, f09a, F19c, F12_b) shift all later positions; values range 1-31 though only 24 fractions exist.

findings.message: SILAM reference channel carries factor 'normal', so convert-openms merges it into the control condition (normal 315 vs PD 99 files-rows); consider marking the reference so it is not counted as a control sample.

findings.message: Source names do not follow <ACCESSION>-Sample-<n> (audit-existing minor); descriptive names are otherwise clear.

'PrP-TetP-hA53T alpha-synuclein transgenic' is a free-text line description, not a registered strain; the paper gives the background (B6C3F2 founders crossed to B6). Acceptable as free text; could name the background.
